info.title: Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform RESTful API

parameters.name: componentNames
parameters.description: Specifies one or more names. The name is the customer name for license-related system events and the device name for all others events

parameters.name: componentTypes
parameters.description: Specifies one or more component type

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Searches for system events that occurred after this date

parameters.name: itemsPerPage
parameters.description: An integer used for paging that indicates the number of collectors to retrieve forthe current page. The default is 100. The maximum value is 1,000

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description:
Specifies the organization. The value that you specify for this parameter indicates how the operation applies to an organization(s). Some parts of the Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform system have separate, non shared data that is organization-specific. Other parts of the system have data that is shared by all organizations. The value that you specify for the organization parameter, as described below, determines to which organization(s) an operation applies:
•	Exact organization name – Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly.
•	All organizations – Indicates that the operation applies to all organizations. In this case, the same data is shared by all organizations.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: An integer used for paging that indicates the required page number

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Specifies a list of strings in JSON format representing the fields by which to sort the results in the following format: %7B"column1":true, "column2":false%7D. True indicates to sort in descending order.Results are sorted by the first field, then by the second field and so on

parameters.name: strictMode
parameters.description: A true/false parameter indicating whether to perform strict matching on the search parameters. The default is False

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Searches for system events that occurred before this date

date.description: Specifies when the system event occurred

organization.description: The organization of the system event
